persistence.scope: Implemented and captured Swift/AppKit macOS journey only.
persistence.evidence: All 16 named native captures exist, show complete nonblank windows and match the states specified by the review brief. Reviewed all nine named approved comps. PRODUCT.md and JOURNEY-V3.md record the approved direction; hero-repro.png is present. Its native window dimensions are an accepted adaptation, not a pixel-reproduction claim.
persistence.provenance: build/desktop-journey-1790791035828. The approval-light filename is a documented legacy name for compact dark appearance. Synthetic conversation and approval content are visibly identified; actual file/diff and conversation switching evidence uses the packaged runtime.

fidelity.assessment: Projects/conversations remain left, conversation dominates the center, and Walkthrough/Changes/Code remain secondary on the right.
Position persists, but the empty square text well and detached action row lose the approved unified chat-entry treatment and visible prompt. J3-F01.
Search, folder opening, pins and rows exist, but the wide library occupies only the left portion of the available main pane; paths truncate and dates wrap while the right remains unused. J3-F02.

A native sheet is an acceptable AppKit adaptation for a protected decision. A raw run_command title and monospaced prose contradict the reference's human-readable question and labeled command. J3-F03.
Disclosure is present, but its dark-mode button stretches into a long pill and separates the chevron from its label. J3-F04.

Centered entry stages, a primary action and existing-setup route preserve the journey. Native buttons and truthful existing-provider wording follow PRODUCT.md and JOURNEY-V3.md; unsupported plan-usage claims are appropriately omitted.

fidelity.element: Files, declarations, changes and previous conversations
fidelity.assessment: Native folder browsing, a bounded declaration selector and read-only previews preserve supporting IDE clarity. Explicit diff baselines and recorded-history wording follow actual runtime authority; decorative timelines and unsupported project indexing are not required.
Conversation/Task context switching preserves the composer and avoids squeezing three panes; native macOS resizing requirements justify the reflow.
System sans-serif hierarchy and monospaced source inspection retain the reference's native character; approval prose is the local exception in J3-F03.
AppKit panels, controls, separators and SF Symbols translate the reference's native surfaces without fake raster texture. The composer grouping remains unresolved in J3-F01.
Sampled central grounds are reference RGB 24/28/34, native dark 36/41/43 and native light 255/255/255. The user's semantic light/dark requirement explicitly permits this appearance change.

ceiling.result: Not reached until J3-F01 through J3-F04 are resolved; no rebuild condition is present.
ceiling.assessment: The approved native hierarchy is established. Remaining unused native devices are a cohesive input group, a fully constrained resizable library, a compact disclosure control and human-readable approval fields.
ceiling.verification_limits: Static native captures and sampled source only; no browser, rendering, UI interaction or test rerun occurred in this review. The parent reports 37 native, 38 desktop and four OAuth-helper tests passing plus type checks and workspace control-bounds checks. Subsequent transport/account changes were reported as nonvisual. No live OAuth/provider task, true light approval sheet, keyboard/IME, VoiceOver, motion, increased contrast, performance or release/distribution acceptance is established. No detector ran.

material_fixes.finding: The primary chat input is an unlabelled empty rectangular editor, with its actions visually detached beneath it.
material_fixes.exact_fix: Group the existing NSTextView scroll area and Send/Queue action row inside one modestly rounded semantic container with a single separator border. Remove the inner bezel border and add a visible Message LUMI… placeholder only while empty. Preserve native text editing, focus, IME, draft, send and queue behavior; do not add unsupported attachment or usage controls.
material_fixes.verify: Check empty and populated input in wide dark and compact light captures; confirm the same native send/queue controls remain reachable.

material_fixes.check: Fidelity: project-library density and resize behavior
material_fixes.finding: The wide main column stops near the window midpoint, truncating the project path and wrapping the date despite substantial unused width.
material_fixes.exact_fix: Constrain main to fill the width remaining after the 200-point sidebar, rather than relying on horizontal stack hugging. Keep its existing insets and make toolbar/table/footer use that width. Give the row date a single line with high horizontal compression resistance; let the project path absorb necessary truncation at the minimum width.
material_fixes.verify: At 1100 and 720 points, the table and toolbar reach the main pane's trailing inset and the date stays on one line without clipping controls.

material_fixes.finding: The approval sheet leads with the internal identifier run_command and presents workspace, reason and command as one undifferentiated monospaced block.
material_fixes.exact_fix: Lead with Allow this operation? and a human-readable operation name, retaining the exact tool identifier as secondary detail. Use system-font Workspace and Reason fields, and reserve selectable monospace for the command/path or raw arguments. Preserve complete payload access, Close/Deny/Allow Once semantics and the one-operation scope statement.
material_fixes.verify: Wide and compact approval captures show the purpose and requested command immediately, retain the full request through scrolling, and keep all decision buttons visible.

material_fixes.finding: The dark activity chevron button stretches across roughly half the transcript row instead of staying next to its label.
material_fixes.exact_fix: Give the disclosure a fixed native control-sized width and height (approximately 20 points) plus required horizontal hugging/compression resistance, or use a native disclosure bezel. Let the title fill the remaining width with the existing small gap; keep the identifier, accessibility label and expand/collapse action.
material_fixes.verify: Collapsed and expanded activity in dark and light keep a compact chevron adjacent to the title without a stretched pill.

keep: Preserve the dominant central conversation, persistent composer, secondary read-only context, native controls and semantic appearances, explicit evidence labels, and LUMI's execution/permission authority.
